errors.detection: Detect via agent/tool timeout log or gateway no response after 300s.
errors.automatic_recovery: Switch to fallback route; checkpoint current task; continue safe artifact work if context is preserved.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry once on alternate provider after 60-120s; do not retry same dead lane more than once.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if all fallback routes fail and no local artifact work remains.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect via fallback chain exhausted / custom unhealthy.
errors.automatic_recovery: Isolate failing fallback, use primary/next healthy lane, create provider-watch note.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry after cooldown or after host health snapshot refresh.
errors.when_to_block: Block system-only if no provider can answer.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect exact unsupported encrypted content error.
errors.automatic_recovery: Remove unsupported encrypted block from prompt, use artifact pointers/checkpoints.
errors.when_to_block: Block if needed data is only encrypted and cannot be re-provided safely.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect 429/insufficient_quota/weekly usage limit.
errors.automatic_recovery: Mark lane unhealthy with reset timing, switch to free/available fallback.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry after reset timing from limits snapshot.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if every approved lane is exhausted.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect context_length_exceeded or compaction failure.
errors.automatic_recovery: Write checkpoint/report, shrink prompt to active task and artifact paths.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry immediately with compact checkpoint-first prompt.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if required context cannot be safely reconstructed.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect summary/compression error in gateway logs.
errors.automatic_recovery: Continue from files/checkpoints, avoid relying on hidden summary.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry after reducing context or switching summary provider.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if no checkpoint exists and task facts are unrecoverable.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect gh wrapper missing binary / exit 127.
errors.owner_visible_message: GitHub CLI is unavailable in sandbox; host recovery queued
errors.automatic_recovery: Create host runner github/autopush job; continue local checks.
errors.when_to_retry: Host runner tick; then PR verify.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if host runner also fails repeatedly.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect fatal could not read Username / auth prompt unavailable.
errors.owner_visible_message: Sandbox cannot push with HTTPS auth; host recovery queued
errors.automatic_recovery: Use host-side Auto-Push with host credentials; never ask owner manual push.
errors.when_to_retry: Host runner tick then gh PR verify.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if write approval/scope missing or host credentials fail.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect gh wrapper message.
errors.owner_visible_message: GitHub wrapper points to missing binary
errors.automatic_recovery: Record as known recoverable class; queue host job and create wrapper repair issue if persistent.
errors.when_to_block: Block system if host job runner missing.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect private repo 404/gh auth fail/stale PR head.
errors.owner_visible_message: PR verification delayed or private auth blocked
errors.automatic_recovery: Write commit-aware status JSON, use host pr-verify job.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry after host runner or remote propagation.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if PR state cannot be proven after host job.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect push failure in Docker.
errors.automatic_recovery: Queue github/autopush job; result path updated; owner manual action = no.
errors.when_to_retry: Host runner tick; verify head SHA.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if host runner FAIL with durable JSON.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect job remains in .hermes-host-jobs root and latest.json not advanced.
errors.owner_visible_message: Host job is queued; waiting for runner
errors.automatic_recovery: Document pending; do not duplicate job unless stale >2 ticks.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry/requeue after 2 host ticks if no movement.
errors.when_to_block: Block system if runner not installed/scheduled.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect job created under non-scanned directory.
errors.automatic_recovery: Move/copy to scanned .hermes-host-jobs root with required marker.
errors.when_to_block: Block if allowlist rejects corrected job.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect result/log allowlist denied.
errors.automatic_recovery: Create corrected job with accepted marker/name; update playbook.
errors.when_to_block: Block system if allowlist needs host runner code change.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect absent /workspace/output/host-job-runner/latest.json.

errors.automatic_recovery: Use job movement/log/result artifacts; request snapshot/runner status via hfinalize.

errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect system job remains pending and no host log.
errors.automatic_recovery: Use correct system/... marker or known scanned root.

errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect missing assets/404/link check failure.

errors.automatic_recovery: Copy assets into deploy dir or change references to relative; gate unavailable motion.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if required production asset absent and cannot be regenerated.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect source contains assets but deployed path lacks them.
errors.automatic_recovery: Copy source assets, rebuild static manifest, rerun verification.

errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect index.html/styles.css/app.js missing.

errors.when_to_block: Block if deploy bridge is unavailable.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect file://,/workspace,/home/hermes in production HTML/CSS/JS visible to client.
errors.automatic_recovery: Replace with relative paths or owner-safe copy labels; do not expose internals client-facing.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if production requires secret/private path.

errors.detection: Detect grep for file:// or /workspace in deployed client surface.

errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect qmd status pending >0.
errors.owner_visible_message: QMD has pending embeddings; safe keyword mode continues
errors.automatic_recovery: Run qmd update/search only; do not run unbounded embed.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry update; defer embed to host maintenance if needed.

errors.detection: Detect request/temptation to run qmd embed without approval or memory headroom.

errors.when_to_retry: Retry only with explicit approval and bounded batch.
errors.when_to_block: Block never for product lane.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect qmd-auto-embed fail/OOM/degraded.
errors.owner_visible_message: Auto-embed degraded; keyword QMD still usable
errors.automatic_recovery: Continue qmd update/search smoke.
errors.when_to_retry: Retry in host window or bounded batch.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if safe update/search fail.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.error: qmd command unavailable in degraded sandbox
errors.detection: Detect command not found/Node mismatch.

errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect hfinalize created flag but not processed yet.

errors.when_to_retry: Retry snapshot status after host processor tick.
errors.when_to_block: Block only if backlog grows/stale beyond SLA.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect pending flags count > threshold.

errors.when_to_block: Block system if stale >45m or >5 pending.
errors.when_to_continue: Continue product lane when owner_action_required=false and safe artifacts/checks can proceed.

errors.detection: Detect last-auto-snapshot older than expected and flags pending.
